items.text: 6A student investigated the amount of heat given out when hexane, CH14, burns using the apparatus in Figure 19.9. Hexane is a highly flammable liquid which is one of the components of petrol (gasoline).

items.label: text
items.text: In each case, the student calculated the amount of heat evolved per mole of hexane. Her first two experiments produced answers of -3200 and -3900 kJ/mol of heat evolved. She then decided to do a third experiment. Her results were as follows:

items.label: table
items.text:
| volume of water in copper calorimeter/cm³   |   100 |
|---------------------------------------------|-------|
| mass of burner + hexane before experiment/g | 35.62 |
| mass of burner + hexane after experiment/g  | 35.23 |
| original temperature of water/°C            |  19.0 |
| final temperature of water/°C               |  55.0 |

items.label: list_item
items.text: a Suggest a reason why the student decided to do a third experiment.

items.label: list_item
items.text: b Apart from wearing eye protection, suggest two other safety precautions the student should take during the experiment.
